title: Shortest Word Distance II
description: Find the shortest distance between two words in a list using a dictionary of indices.
pseudocode:
1. Map each word to a list of its indices in the input array.
2. Retrieve indices list1 for word1 and list2 for word2.
3. Use two pointers i and j to compare indices in list1 and list2.
4. Update minDistance by taking abs(list1[i] - list2[i]) and increment the smaller pointer.

steps.note: Compare list1[0]=0 and list2[0]=1. Distance = |0-1| = 1. Min = 1.
Increment i because list1[0] < list2[0]. list1[1]=3, list2[0]=1. Distance = |3-1| = 2.
Min distance remains 1. Pointer i exceeds list1 bounds.
